status_at_freeze: before_any_spatial_ranking_result; implemented diagnostic not a method claim
query_rule: Exact cached RandomState(44).permutation(100000)[:10000] material sample IDs; reuse cached face IDs and barycentric weights, not mesh vertex IDs

model_only_scores.stageI_sample_distance: mean_t min_j ||P_native[t,i]-S_stageI[t,j]|| against exact cached 50000-point Stage-I samples

score_coordinates: Raw canonical model coordinates; no GT, camera, alignment matrix or GT-derived scaling passed to score functions
stageI_distance_scope: Monte Carlo sampled-surface approximation, not exact nearest triangle distance; use existing probe sample seed=20261002+frame, 50000 points, no resampling or density selection
pre_execution_schema_correction: Actual cached probe measurement metadata and source default show sample seed20261002+frame (20261010,20261017), distinct from generation seed42. Corrected before implementation or any score/outcome computation; cached samples never changed.
target: Mean frames8/15 forward-direction conditional displacement EPE: ||(P_aligned[t,i]-P_aligned[0,i])-(G[t,nu(i)]-G[0,nu(i)])||. nu is exact saved frame0 predicted-to-GT NN map. No rematching; cached shared-anchor transform and hash-qualified aligned native cloud reused.
target_scope: Conditional on possibly incorrect anchor NN match; not material ground truth, bidirectional CD-M or full16-frame benchmark metric

reconstruction_verification.reason: NumPy float32 barycentric and cached affine arithmetic versus original PyTorch float32 cache; verification only, never score/GT tuning

ranking: Spearman as Pearson correlation of average ranks of exact ties; no p-values. Nonfinite inputs rejected; zero-variance score or outcome returns undefined/null.
risk_selection: Reject exactly highest1000 of10000 scores (10%), ordered by descending score then ascending original material sample ID. ID tie-break is arbitrary, not evidence of prediction; report boundary-tie counts. Constant scores produce no arbitrary risk result.

risk_metrics.risk_enrichment: mean target among rejected highest10% / overall target mean
risk_metrics.retained_risk: mean target among retained90%; also divide by overall mean
risk_metrics.dependence: Enrichment and retained-risk ratio encode the same fixed-fraction selection contrast, not independent tests

oracle_confound_only: GT anchor NN distance ||P_aligned[0,i]-G[0,nu(i)]||, explicitly labelled ORACLE unavailable at inference; rank against outcome and correlate with model scores. Never combine into or select a usable score.
descriptive_screen: On EACH asset reversal must have strictly larger Spearman AND higher top10% risk enrichment than BOTH simple scores; retained risk is reported but algebraically redundant. Undefined comparison cannot pass. No statistical or novelty clearance implied.
inference_scope: Within-asset correlated material points and two repeated frames; no pointwise independent p-values/bootstrap. Report each asset and both-asset descriptive screen, never pool points as independent samples.
prohibited: retuning frames, seeds, cutoffs, scores or nearest maps
choosing Stage-I sampling density after outcomes
calling direction sensitivity calibrated uncertainty or a new method
